title: Authorized accepted photo reaches the real vision model

given.actor: current Boss or granted Engineer for an active Plant
given.photo: committed tomato fixture accepted through production photo intake with matching catalog size and sha256
given.binding: canonical vision_observation agent bound explicitly to a Gemini image-capable model

when.action: run the internal Vision Observation command for that Plant and photo

then.provider: exactly one real call receives the strict request and verified in-memory photo bytes
then.decision: the committed tomato fixture returns runtime_decision=speak; clarify and silent do not satisfy this behavior
then.handoff: speak produces one pending non-consumable MessageEnvelope and one matching VisionStateCandidateV1
then.authority: no direct Plant-state, Bus, UI, task, Safety, or confirmation effect occurs
